name: hermes-pilot
description: The A2B pipeline for an autonomous Hermes Agent, in your pocket: turn a one-line Spec Seed into a Quick Review interview, a spec the batch runner can execute, filed kanban batches, live monitoring and a Mission Receipt — plus annotation, chat, terminal and usage in one installable PWA.
author: Hermes Pilot contributors

commands.init: First-run setup: data directories, 256-bit token (0600), bundled skills, pairing QR
commands.start: Build the UI when needed and run the bridge (--port, --host, --tls-port)
commands.qr: Print the pairing URL candidates and a terminal QR code
commands.service: install | uninstall | restart | status (launchd on macOS, systemd --user on Linux)
commands.migrate: Copy data from the legacy akapen / mobile-pwa layout

service.legacy: ai.hermes.hermes-mobile is intentionally left running during migration; see README
